methodology: One independent whole-batch factual web pass. All forty dexonline JSON requests were serialized with at least 2.1 seconds after each response; selected exact DEX/DOOM 3 records were inspected. Accepted scoped links were checked on Romanian secondary or direct-domain pages; indexed STB instruction excerpts were used where the scanned PDF viewer timed out. Wikționar is a second website, not a claim of independent lexical provenance. Live normalized owners and folded duplicates were checked read-only. No authored item, module, pool, runtime, gate or state file was changed.

items.rationale: Preserve the hold. Exact clothing sense and feminine DOOM 3 forms agree, but the fourth Căciulă association remains a winter-equipment co-listing without a qualified four-link proposal.

Exact clothing-fastener/decorative noun and masculine DOOM 3 paradigm agree. DEX supports clothing use; live shirt and jacket descriptions and the manufacturer catalogue verify the qualified shirt, jacket and trouser closures. Possible-use captions preserve decorative exceptions.

Exact sewn-clothing-compartment sense and neuter DOOM 3 paradigm agree. DEX supports the clothing relation; live garment descriptions and the manufacturer catalogue verify pockets on trousers, jackets and shirts. Existing garment scopes match the four captions.

Exact enclosure sense and neuter DOOM 3 forms agree. The second source explicitly describes yard/garden/property enclosure and wood construction. All four targets retain their literal household/material scopes; the prior monumental-gate mismatch is absent.

Exact glass food-storage vessel and neuter DOOM 3 paradigm agree. Actual jam and winter-pickle recipes independently verify preservation, the two named food families and a lid closure; only the accepted batch Capac supplies its one new target.

Exact movable vessel-cover sense and neuter DOOM 3 paradigm agree. The cookware maker documents covered pots/saucepans and a frying pan with a lid; the jam recipe verifies a jar lid. Captions state possible use and preserve kitchen scope.

Exact coffee-pot sense and neuter DOOM 3 forms agree. The coffee producer recipe explicitly uses an ibric, coffee, measured water and an aragaz heat source. The general drink and named preparation remain distinct existing destinations.

Exact perforated kitchen vessel/cloth-strainer senses and DOOM 3 strecurătorii/strecurători forms agree. The seller directly describes draining pasta and vegetables with pot clips; DEX explicitly verifies cloth straining of curd to remove whey. Each caption specifies its applicable subtype.

Preserve the hold. Exact DEX bird sense is Passer domesticus and DOOM 3 supports the forms; the submitted research still does not establish the precise wheat-food claim, so generic grain evidence cannot qualify all four planned links.

Exact bird sense and DOOM 3 ciocănitori/ciocănitorii paradigm agree. The Romanian zoological article independently describes the strong bill, tree bark/wood pecking and insect/larval food. Four scoped captions follow those facts; one destination is accepted batch Cioc.

Exact anatomical cioc headword and neuter DOOM 3 forms agree. Romanian sources describe bird jaws with a horny covering, bony support and the woodpecker bill. Gură and Os keep their anatomical existing scopes; the four captions do not introduce the object-spout or human-beard senses.

Exact insect noun and masculine DOOM 3 paradigm agree. The Romanian insect page verifies blood-feeding females and aquatic larvae; the garden article explicitly names mosquito larvae as frog food. Qualified sex/species and possible-prey wording avoids universal claims.

Exact earthworm sense and feminine DOOM 3 forms agree. The Romanian animal article verifies soil habitat and organic feeding; the Milvus educational guide explicitly identifies worms as important hedgehog food, and the fishing source verifies bait use. Animal, Pământ, Arici and Pește scopes match.

Preserve the hold. Exact insect sense and DOOM 3 forms agree, but the batch does not provide verified precise wheat food and Arici-prey claims. General seeds or insect prey are insufficient to assert those two named links.

Exact DEX sense is Coccinella septempunctata, reflected in the restricted seven-spot description; DOOM 3 forms agree. Romanian reporting explicitly documents ladybirds eating aphids while searching pepper leaves and protecting crops. Insect, Plantă, Frunză and batch Afid captions are supported.

The proposal correctly uses exact lemma Afid, DEX98 insect sense and DOOM 3 neuter afide paradigm. The biological and Romanian agriculture sources verify insect identity, plant sap feeding, leaf undersides and ladybird predation. No feminine afidă input or alternative owner is silently introduced.

Preserve the hold. Exact DEX arachnid sense and masculine DOOM 3 forms agree; the literal animal/insect-food claims do not by themselves establish the two precise Fluture and Țânțar prey links. No unsupported fourth-link inference is admitted.
Preserve the hold. DOOM 3 explicitly permits greier/greiere and the submitted forms fit that norm, but the precise Iarbă, Frunză and Arici-prey claims remain unqualified as a complete four-link set.

Exact vehicle-control sense and neuter DOOM 3 forms agree. Renault describes driver intention at the steering wheel and vehicle direction; indexed STB bus instructions independently identify its drivers at the wheel. The four captions retain literal vehicle, driver and steering-wheel scopes; Wikționar supplies forms rather than the selected automotive sense.

Exact front protective glass sense and DOOM 3 parbrize paradigm agree. Romanian vehicle sources verify protection and front glazing, indexed STB instructions explicitly mention bus windscreen equipment, and the local report documents a parking note at the windscreen. All four existing-owner scopes match.

Exact vehicle-wheel sense and DOOM 3 roți/roții paradigm agree; the archaic/popular roate variant is excluded. Romanian vehicle descriptions corroborate wheeled land transport, explicit bicycle components and motorcycle wheels; the four ordinary part captions retain vehicle-wheel scope without machinery/metaphorical senses.

Exact vehicle tyre sense and feminine DOOM 3 forms agree. The Romanian tyre article verifies rim mounting/contact and winter variants; the tyre maker explicitly documents car, motorcycle and bicycle applications. The seasonal-set caption matches the existing Cauciucurile de iarnă owner.

Exact urban-traffic sense and neuter DOOM 3 forms agree. The Romanian police primary-school guide explicitly distinguishes driver signals and identifies red as stop, including the vehicle stopping rule. Car, Șofer, Roșu and visible Lumină scopes match the four qualified road-signal captions.

Exact electric public-road-vehicle sense and neuter DOOM 3 forms agree. The Romanian transport article verifies bus-like body, electric traction, driver provision and urban road routes. Four captions preserve a trolleybus identity rather than equating it with a battery bus.

Exact railway traction-vehicle sense and feminine DOOM 3 forms agree. The Romanian railway article verifies carriage traction, steam-engine water replenishment at stations, electric traction and ordinary wheel-based rail vehicles. Steam-only wording on the station claim preserves the generic locomotive scope.
